signals.oi_expansion_continuation: 4h OI change crosses <=0 to >0; trade sign(4h price return)
signals.oi_contraction_reversal: 4h OI change crosses >=0 to <0; trade -sign(4h price return)

early_gate: Proceed only if a family has overall 4h signed mean >= 0.10% and >=3/4 symbols positive. No threshold/window tuning.
